Could you provide more specific details about what is failing? This discussion is related to the software [product_name]. Which exact model are you using? Please include the full [article_no]. If you have a project file and a separate program file, consider uploading both as a zip archive.

This thread is being closed because the question was posted more than once. The duplicate topic, '[product_name] Version [version_no] Counters', is available in the [product_name] - Software conference. Best regards, [user_name]
